title: Over and Over
about: A song lesson for an A2+ student. The band has no official music video, so this is the band’s own upload of the record (the album cover, a still picture); lrclib’s lyrics match it exactly. Merged with the phrasal-verbs version of Nov 25 (pull away, keep on). Lines without a word to learn now are heard in All together only.
skipped: 0:00–0:15 is the intro and 1:04–1:10 a short break. 1:24–1:50 repeats Part 2, and 2:32–3:12 repeats Parts 2 and 4 (the last chorus), so they’re left out.

words: Don’t be angry with him. I’m the one to blame.
lines.meaning: “It” is his love for someone who is bad for him, and he knows it’s his own fault.

words: I’ve tried everything, but I still can’t sleep.
I need to get away for the weekend.
Here I go again, eating cake at midnight.
lines.note: We say it when we do the same thing again, often a bad habit.

words: I watched that movie over and over.
He fell for her the first time he saw her.
lines.note: fall – fell – fallen: I fell for you.

words: I try not to eat sweets at night.
lines.note: The end is left out: I try not to (fall for you).

words: I can’t pull away from my phone.

lines.note: even goes before the verb: don’t even try, didn’t even say.

words: can’t get it out of my head
I love that song. I can’t get it out of my head.
hl: can’t get out of my head
lines.note: We say it about a song, a thought or a picture: I can’t get it out of my head.

words: I wanted tea, but I got coffee instead.
lines.note: instead usually comes at the end of the sentence.
lines.meaning: He knows this love is bad for him, but he still wants it.

lines.note: keep on + -ing = don’t stop: I’ll keep on wasting = I’ll still waste.

it.it feels: it — «воно»: it feels like = здається, ніби. It тут потрібне, бо в англійському реченні завжди є підмет.

gloss.everyday: щодня (так у пісні; правильно every day, окремо)

it’s.*: усе (it’s all the same = усе однаково; it’s = it is)
it’s.it’s dragging: це (it’s = it is: is + dragging = зараз тягне)

all.*: усе (it’s all the same = усе однаково)
all.all my time: весь (all my time = весь свій час)

the.*: the same = той самий, однаковий: перед same завжди the.
the.the one: (the one to blame = той, хто винен)

me.make me: мене (make me fall for you = змушуєш мене закохуватися в тебе)
me.for me: мене (best for me = найкраще для мене)

gloss.one: той (the one to blame = той, хто винен)

to.try not to: to тут замість цілої фрази: I try not to (fall for you) = я намагаюся не (закохуватися).
to.try to live: to + дієслово: try to live = намагаюся жити

gloss.blame: звинувачувати (the one to blame = той, хто винен)
gloss.i’ve: я (I’ve tried = I have tried: я вже спробував)

get.get out of: (get … out of my head = викинути з голови)

gloss.here: ось (here I go again = ну от, знову)
gloss.go: (here I go again = ну от, знову я за своє)

do.why do: do — допоміжне слово для питання: Why do I…? = Навіщо я…? Саме do не перекладаємо.
do.time I do: роблю (це) (every time I do = щоразу, як я це роблю)

try.even try: намагаєшся (you don’t even try = ти навіть не намагаєшся)

gloss.stays: залишається (stays the same = залишається таким самим)
gloss.make: змушуєш (make me fall for you = змушуєш мене закохуватися)
gloss.that: які (thoughts that I can’t… = думки, які я не можу…)
gloss.out: (get out of my head = викинути з голови)

my.my time: свій (all my time = весь свій час)

gloss.head: голова
gloss.what’s: що (what’s = what is: what’s best for me = що для мене найкраще)
gloss.i’ll: я (I’ll = I will: I’ll keep on = я й далі буду)
